title: Custom Battler Sprite sheet for less sprite s?

posts.author: doodoosalad
posts.body:
So I'm trying to create a custom Sprite sheet for my battlers that have less than 54 sprites in their sheet
The reason I want it is for the "yanfly animated sv enemy" plugin. (The same with the normal battlers so it doesn't matter)
Since the animated battlers/enemies in my battle are resized and are much larger, it gets really hard to draw over the resized Sprite sheet bc of how big it is(makes my drawing app run slower), causes the game to lag, and even glitch.
So I thought the perfect solution for this is to try to make a "custom Sprite sheet" where the Sprite sheet has at least 18 sprites in it instead of 54 like it is in the default one so it gets much easier to draw over it and less laggy.
I don't know if I need to do some coding or a plugin,, but please let me know!!
Here's an example of what I want:

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
yes, you'll need a plugin.
but even more you'll need to understand the true format of the battlers and why calling it a 54 or 18 sprite sheet is not advisable.
Please check the help file for the definition of the battler sheet. You'll see that it is defined by 18 sequences of 3 frames, and that those 18 sequences are named for poses or motions or states.
The engine uses those poses, which means if you want to reduce the use in the battlescreen to 6 of those poses or motions, you'll need to decide which of them to remove.
and then request a plugin that removes exactly those poses from the game while reformatting the kept pose sequences to the new battler sheet.
by the way - what is the cell size you're using for your battlers?
